3560-6888-8095.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1849-3259-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7060-7279.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7279.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Razorkin Hordecaller triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

679-5436-6282.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in your graveyard.
You have a way to lose life.
679-5436-6282.description:
Lose life by any method.
Lich's Mastery's second ability triggers, causing you to exile a card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and draw a card.
Lich's Mastery second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Resolve the Lich's Mastery trigger, exiling a card from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

2292-4053-7134--145.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

11-121-2631-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-121-2631-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Alrund's Epiphany by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Alrund's Epiphany.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Alrund's Epiphany spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Alrund's Epiphany spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Alrund's Epiphany and returning the original Alrund's Epiphany to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Alrund's Epiphany from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1479-2841-6157-6528.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-6157-6528.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

14-147-5231.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4613-6878.description:
Activate Qala by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Qala triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5147-5572-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5147-5572-6249--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

129-1247-5268.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Kinnan triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

573-803-1399-1606.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gruul Turf.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

813-961-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Against All Odds.
813-961-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

116-5241-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima's Student on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Sakashima's Student do not have summoning sickness.
116-5241-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Sakashima's Student.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Sakashima's Student.
Activate Sakashima's Student by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2867-4840-4871-5147.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment four times by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and three Myr tokens.
When Myr Battlesphere and the Myr tokens die, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability and Pitiless Plunderer each trigger four times.
Resolve all Demon of Dark Schemes triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve all Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 4 damage to any target.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Demon of Dark Schemes by paying {2}{B} and {E}{E}{E}{E}, putting Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-3685-3764-4497.notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3685-3764-4497.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, triggering itself and Summoning Station.
Resolve the Summoning Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
The Pincher enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Repeat.

907-1479-2638.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-2638.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Tracker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2302-4050-4215-5229.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ulamog, adding one mana of any color.
Ulamog and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Ulamog trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Ulamog, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
